description: This file defines interfaces for an IPC server and client within the Rialto project, including classes IClient and IServer, which facilitate client connection management, message sending, and server operation in a protobuf-based IPC system.

classes.name: IClient
classes.description: Interface representing a connected client, providing methods to query client info, send messages, and manage connection.

classes.name: IServer
classes.description: Interface representing the IPC server, providing methods to manage sockets, clients, and process I/O events.

methods.name: addSocket
methods.description: Creates a listening socket for incoming client connections, with optional callbacks for connection events.

methods.name: addClient
methods.description: Creates a client object from a socket file descriptor, adding it to the server for communication.

methods.name: fd
methods.description: Returns an external file descriptor for event loop integration.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Waits for I/O events or timeout, blocking until activity occurs or timeout expires.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Handles incoming connections and data, and sends data back to clients.
